mentions.description: A web browser designed for AI agents as the main users, built without Chromium and CDP, optimizing for token efficiency, state, and loops over traditional UX.
mentions.problem: Traditional browsers and UX are designed for humans, not for agent-driven use where token efficiency, state, and loops matter most.
